completed.basis: direct jobs[].finished_at from exhaustive offset-free organization-wide bounded disjoint parent-created query units
completed.limitation: A job dynamically added after its unit was read, or belonging to a parent build created before the bounded source horizon can also escape all parent-build filters.

incoming.basis: direct jobs[].runnable_at from exhaustive offset-free organization-wide bounded disjoint parent-created query units
incoming.limitation: A job dynamically added after its unit was read, or belonging to a parent build created before the bounded source horizon can also escape all parent-build filters.

served.basis: direct jobs[].started_at from exhaustive offset-free organization-wide bounded disjoint parent-created query units
served.limitation: A job dynamically added after its unit was read, or belonging to a parent build created before the bounded source horizon can also escape all parent-build filters.

coverage.reason: All organization-wide disjoint query units and target queue IDs were collected, but jobs added after a unit completed and jobs belonging to parent builds before the bounded source horizon cannot be proven absent. Direct observed event timestamps remain exact. Target queues absent from the Buildkite cluster are out of scope and their zero rows are not measurements: amd_mi250_8.

provenance.retry_semantics: Every hashed job UUID is one attempt. is_retry means retry_source, retry_type, or a positive retries_count was present; retried marks an attempt superseded by another retry. Throughput counts attempts, not retry chains.

source_field_contract.daily_wait_times: every non-null queue_wait_seconds observation grouped by the UTC date of started_at
source_field_contract.queue: builds[].jobs[].cluster_queue_id resolved through the cluster queues endpoint
source_field_contract.queue_wait_seconds: started_at - runnable_at; null unless both direct timestamps exist
source_field_contract.runtime_seconds: finished_at - started_at; null unless both direct timestamps exist
